notes.title: Update Notes for oct 21
notes.content:
New character and content added! Change language in-game! Bug Fixes!


 New character added. Marty from Saturday Morning RPG is available with several unlocks
 New background, tile set and song have been added from the previous release of Cylinder
 Language select added to options menu
 Photosensitivity warning added when starting game
 Fixes around online disconnects and controller disconnects
 Fixed bug related to online scores getting out of sync
 Fixed UI issues when language is set to Korean or Russian 
 Fixed issue where selecting opponents to attack would also rotate tiles
 Fixed overlay integration when pausing in  multiplayer games

notes.title: Update Notes for Sept 23
notes.content: Fix for some incorrect button prompts in the Tutorial

notes.title: Soundtrack and Full Translations available now!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We're happy to announce that the Cylinder: Puzzles Returned soundtrack is now available to purchase!

We also have the full Non-English tranlations included in the game and Steam Achievements.

Korean

notes.title: Update Notes for Sept 19
notes.content:
Complete non-english translations have been added
Resolved bug with 6 achievements not firing
Resolved bug with offline achievements not syncing
Added 3 new objectives to objective race: clear with beam tiles, 5-tile matches, 6-tile matches
Added 5-tile through 12-tile matches to lifetime stats page
Added objective race "allow hard objectives" toggle to disable silver tile/6-tile match objectives
